question: Analyze gene expression data from multiple patients across different time points. Build a hierarchical model with patient-level random effects and time-level fixed effects. Use MCMC sampling to estimate parameters and report posterior distributions for the random effects variance. Set the first time point as the reference level (time_effects[0] = 0) for identifiability.

expected_output.guidelines: Posterior mean and credible interval for each time effect and variance parameter must be present; time effects must increase monotonically across time points; sigma_patient and sigma_error posterior means must be within 20% relative absolute error of the reference.
Column means must be within 20% relative absolute error of the reference; sample count may differ.

Trace plot must show MCMC sample paths over iterations for all population-level parameters (intercept, time effects, patient-level SD, and error SD); axis labels, color scheme, and styling may differ.
